lines.say: On a bad-air morning in Delhi, a teacher with forty-four children has one question.
lines.show: On a bad-air morning in Delhi, a teacher with 44 children has one question.

lines.say: Open the window, or keep it shut?
lines.show: Open the window, or keep it shut?

lines.say: Keep it shut, and the children's own breath pushes carbon dioxide past two thousand parts per million in a single period.
lines.show: Keep it shut, and the children's own breath pushes CO₂ past 2,000 ppm in a single period.

lines.say: The room turns stuffy, and attention drops.
lines.show: The room turns stuffy, and attention drops.

lines.say: Open it, and almost all of the smog outside comes in.
lines.show: Open it, and almost all of the smog outside comes in.

lines.say: Khidkee, the Hindi word for window, answers that question minute by minute.
lines.show: Khidki, the Hindi word for window, answers that question minute by minute.

lines.say: It tells the teacher exactly when to open, and when to close.
lines.show: It tells the teacher exactly when to open, and when to close.

lines.say: Children breathe fresher air, the teacher is interrupted less, and the principal sees every classroom on one page.
lines.show: Children breathe fresher air, the teacher is interrupted less, and the principal sees every classroom on one page.

lines.say: How does it know when, without extra hardware?
lines.show: How does it know when, without extra hardware?

lines.say: Khidkee keeps a physics twin of the classroom: how fast forty-four children add carbon dioxide, and how much smog each window setting lets in.
lines.show: Khidki keeps a physics twin of the classroom: how fast 44 children add CO₂, and how much smog each window setting lets in.

lines.say: Every morning at six, it takes the outdoor air forecast and the timetable, tests the day in five-minute steps, and keeps the plan with the best balance.
lines.show: Every morning at six, it takes the outdoor air forecast and the timetable, tests the day in five-minute steps, and keeps the plan with the best balance.

lines.say: School safety rules are written as Cedar policies, so every decision shows the rule and the number behind it.
lines.show: School safety rules are written as Cedar policies, so every decision shows the rule and the number behind it.

lines.say: During the day, the teacher sees one calm instruction, in Hindi and English.
lines.show: During the day, the teacher sees one calm instruction, in Hindi and English.

lines.say: One tap says it's done.
lines.show: One tap says it's done.

lines.say: Khidkee never asks more than six times a day.
lines.show: Khidki never asks more than six times a day.

lines.say: Did the window really open? There is no sensor on the window.
lines.show: Did the window really open? There is no sensor on the window.

lines.say: The children's breath is the tracer gas, so one ordinary carbon dioxide meter is enough.
lines.show: The children's breath is the tracer gas, so one ordinary CO₂ meter is enough.

lines.say: How fast the level falls tells Khidkee how open the room is.
lines.show: How fast the level falls tells Khidki how open the room is.

lines.say: If only one side opened, it asks for the other.
lines.show: If only one side opened, it asks for the other.

lines.say: An A W S Step Functions workflow waits for the tap, waits for the air, and then verifies.
lines.show: An AWS Step Functions workflow waits for the tap, waits for the air, and then verifies.

lines.say: Here is how it is built. Readings come in through A P I Gateway to Lambda, and live in DynamoDB.
lines.show: Here is how it is built. Readings come in through API Gateway to Lambda, and live in DynamoDB.

lines.say: EventBridge starts the six A M plan, Step Functions runs every instruction, and Polly speaks it in Hindi.
lines.show: EventBridge starts the 6 AM plan, Step Functions runs every instruction, and Polly speaks it in Hindi.

lines.say: The whole stack is one C D K app.
lines.show: The whole stack is one CDK app.

lines.say: Under the hood, the twin and the planner are Python and NumPy: dynamic programming for the plan, a least-squares fit for the window check.
lines.show: Under the hood, the twin and the planner are Python and NumPy: dynamic programming for the plan, a least-squares fit for the window check.

lines.say: The screens are React and TypeScript.
lines.show: The screens are React and TypeScript.

lines.say: One hundred and thirty-one automated tests keep it honest, and everything also runs on a laptop with no cloud.
lines.show: 131 automated tests keep it honest, and everything also runs on a laptop with no cloud.

lines.say: We tested it on forty-eight real Delhi school days from last winter, in a simulated classroom.
lines.show: We tested it on 48 real Delhi school days from last winter, in a simulated classroom.

lines.say: Against a carbon dioxide alarm, Khidkee cut stuffy minutes from sixty-five a day to seventeen, with four requests to the teacher instead of fifteen.
lines.show: Against a CO₂ alarm, Khidki cut stuffy minutes from 65 a day to 17, with 4 requests to the teacher instead of 15.

lines.say: It lets in a little more smog to do that, and we say so plainly.
lines.show: It lets in a little more smog to do that, and we say so plainly.

lines.say: In this hackathon we built the teacher's screen, the principal's page, and a timetable any school can print with no sensor at all.
lines.show: In this hackathon we built the teacher's screen, the principal's page, and a timetable any school can print with no sensor at all.

lines.say: It is deployed on A W S, and the code is open.
lines.show: It is deployed on AWS, and the code is open.

lines.say: Khidkee. Open the window at the right minute.
lines.show: Khidki. Open the window at the right minute.
